labels.name: Neural tube
labels.function: Sclerotome cells encircling it form the vertebral arch

labels.name: Neural crest cells
labels.function: Forms most of the facial skeleton and the frontal bone

labels.name: Notochord
labels.function: Becomes the gelatinous center of each disc

labels.name: Dermatome
labels.function: Gives rise to the connective-tissue layer of the skin

labels.name: Myotome
labels.function: Source of all skeletal muscle of its body segment

labels.name: Sclerotome
labels.function: Forms vertebrae, ribs and the outer ring of the disc

labels.name: Somatic lateral plate mesoderm
labels.function: Core of the limb bud; forms limb bones and connective tissue

labels.name: Surface ectoderm
labels.function: Covers the limb bud; thickens at its tip into a signaling ridge

labels.name: Apical ectodermal ridge
labels.function: Distal rim secreting FGFs; drives proximal-to-distal growth

labels.name: Zone of polarizing activity
labels.function: Posterior mesoderm secreting SHH; sets the thumb-to-pinky axis

labels.name: Progress zone
labels.function: Dividing mesoderm under the ridge; retinoic acid halts it

labels.name: Somatic lateral plate mesoderm
labels.function: Bud core forming limb bones, cartilage and connective tissue

labels.name: Myogenic precursor cells
labels.function: Migrate in from somites to form the limb's muscles

labels.name: Digital ray
labels.function: Hyaline cartilage model of a future finger

labels.name: Interdigital tissue
labels.function: Removed by apoptosis in weeks 7-8; failure fuses digits

labels.name: Frontal bone
labels.function: Vault bone formed mainly from neural crest

labels.name: Parietal bone
labels.function: Paired side-vault bones from paraxial mesoderm

labels.name: Occipital bone
labels.function: Rear vault bone; paraxial mesoderm contributes

labels.name: Sagittal suture
labels.function: Its early fusion gives a long narrow head (scaphocephaly)

labels.name: Coronal suture
labels.function: Fibrous joint between the front and side vault bones

labels.name: Lambdoid suture
labels.function: Fibrous joint between the side vault bones and the rear one

labels.name: Anterior fontanelle
labels.function: Largest soft spot, where four vault bones meet

labels.name: Posterior fontanelle
labels.function: Small triangular soft spot at the rear midline
